response.justification: While Bogdan meets the minimum education and experience requirements (BS + 20 years professional experience), he lacks the specialized hardware architecture expertise essential for this Principal-level role. His entire career has focused on web and backend software development with no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture analysis, deep learning workload optimization, or hardware-software co-design. Although he has performed optimization work in high-performance systems, there is insufficient evidence of the hardware-level architectural knowledge and domain expertise required for this position.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated ability to optimize high-performance, low-latency systems handling millions of operations per second
Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq, showing exposure to AI technologies and infrastructure development
Strong full-stack technical depth across multiple languages and distributed systems, indicating broad problem-solving capabilities
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware design, which is a core responsibility of the Principal Performance Architect role
Career trajectory is entirely in software/backend development with no evidence of GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD systems, or hardware-level optimization experience
No background in deep learning inference/training optimization or AI accelerator workload analysis, critical requirements for this hardware-focused position

key_factors.factor: SoC/IP Modeling and Hardware Design Experience
AI Accelerator and GPU Architecture Expertise
